contract_profile.name: CErc20Delegator (cUSDC market, representative of Compound V2's cToken architecture)
contract_profile.architectural_role: Interest-bearing receipt token representing a supplied position in a single-asset Compound V2 lending market; also the entry point for mint, redeem, borrow, and repay operations on that market.
contract_profile.description: CErc20Delegator is an unstructured-storage delegatecall proxy that forwards all calls not explicitly handled by the delegator itself to a separate CErc20Delegate (or, for the DAI market, CDaiDelegate) implementation contract, while keeping all state in the proxy's own storage. A single admin address controls which implementation the proxy points to.
evidence: contract CErc20Delegator is CErc20Interface, CDelegatorInterface, CTokenInterface
constructor sets admin = payable(msg.sender), then calls _setImplementation(implementation_, false, becomeImplementationData), then sets admin = admin_

architectural_patterns.name: Delegator/Delegate Upgradeable Proxy
architectural_patterns.description: The market contract (CErc20Delegator) holds all storage and forwards unrecognised calls via delegatecall to a separately deployed implementation contract (CErc20Delegate or CDaiDelegate), which executes in the delegator's own storage context.
evidence: function _setImplementation(address implementation_, bool allowResign, bytes memory becomeImplementationData) override public { require(msg.sender == admin, "CErc20Delegator::_setImplementation: Caller must be admin"); ... }
CDaiDelegate.sol: function _becomeImplementation(bytes memory data) override public
CDaiDelegate.sol: function _resignImplementation() override public

architectural_patterns.name: External Policy Engine (Comptroller) Gating
architectural_patterns.description: Market-level actions (mint, borrow) are not solely gated by the market contract itself; they call out to a separate Comptroller contract's hook functions, which can independently allow or reject the action.
evidence: Comptroller.sol: function mintAllowed(address cToken, address minter, uint mintAmount) override external returns (uint) { require(!mintGuardianPaused[cToken], "mint is paused"); ... }
Comptroller.sol: function borrowAllowed(...) ... require(!borrowGuardianPaused[cToken], "borrow is paused"); ...

internal_modules.name: Interest Accrual Module
internal_modules.description: Tracks and compounds borrow interest using a per-block rate sourced from an external InterestRateModel contract, applied to totalBorrows and totalReserves on each accrueInterest() call.
evidence: CToken.sol: interestRateModel state variable of type InterestRateModel
borrowRatePerBlock() and supplyRatePerBlock() delegate to interestRateModel

privileged_entities.name: admin
permissions: Add/reduce reserves and other admin-gated maintenance functions
evidence: address payable public admin (CTokenInterfaces.sol)
require(msg.sender == admin, "CErc20Delegator::_setImplementation: Caller must be admin")
_setReserveFactorFresh: if (msg.sender != admin) { revert SetReserveFactorAdminCheck(); }

privileged_entities.name: Pause Guardian (Comptroller-level)
privileged_entities.role: Protocol-wide operational authority able to unilaterally freeze new supply or borrow activity per market
evidence: Comptroller.sol: function _setMintPaused(CToken cToken, bool state) public returns (bool) { ... mintGuardianPaused[address(cToken)] = state; }
Comptroller.sol: function _setBorrowPaused(CToken cToken, bool state) public returns (bool) { ... borrowGuardianPaused[address(cToken)] = state; }

Real governance record: a Compound DAO proposal to pause new supply and borrow across all V2 markets and raise every market's reserve factor to 100% passed with unanimous community support and was scheduled for on-chain execution on 20 Oct 2025 (source: Compound Community Forum, '[Gauntlet] Compound V2 Deprecation Proposal') -- direct evidence that this authority is not merely theoretical but has actually been exercised at protocol scope.

upstream_dependencies.name: Comptroller
upstream_dependencies.architectural_role: External contract each market defers to for mint/borrow authorization decisions before executing the underlying transfer logic.
evidence: CToken.sol: comptroller.mintAllowed(...) style hook calls precede mintFresh's own logic

upstream_dependencies.name: InterestRateModel
upstream_dependencies.architectural_role: External, per-market-swappable contract that computes the current borrow rate from a market's cash, borrows, and reserves figures.
evidence: CToken.sol: interestRateModel.getBorrowRate(cash, borrows, reserves) style call inside accrueInterest()

upstream_dependencies.name: Underlying ERC-20 Token
upstream_dependencies.architectural_role: The asset each market wraps; the market's own token balance of this asset is a direct input to the market's exchange rate computation.
evidence: CErc20.sol: function getCashPrior() virtual override internal view returns (uint) { EIP20Interface token = EIP20Interface(underlying); return token.balanceOf(address(this)); }

upgradeability.upgrade_authority: admin (single address, governance model not determinable from source alone)
upgrade_flow: admin calls _setImplementation(newImplementation, allowResign, becomeImplementationData) on the CErc20Delegator proxy
Proxy optionally calls _resignImplementation() on the outgoing implementation via delegatecall
Proxy updates its stored implementation address
Proxy calls _becomeImplementation(becomeImplementationData) on the new implementation via delegatecall
evidence: function _setImplementation(address implementation_, bool allowResign, bytes memory becomeImplementationData) override public { require(msg.sender == admin, "CErc20Delegator::_setImplementation: Caller must be admin"); ... }

financial_mechanisms.name: Exchange Rate Computation
financial_mechanisms.description: The market's exchangeRate (used to convert between the interest-bearing receipt token and the underlying asset) is computed from getCashPrior(), totalBorrows, totalReserves, and totalSupply. For standard markets, getCashPrior() returns the market contract's own raw ERC-20 balanceOf(address(this)) reading of the underlying token -- a value that can be increased by ANY direct ERC-20 transfer to the market contract, not only by the market's own mint() entry point.
evidence: CErc20.sol: getCashPrior() returns EIP20Interface(underlying).balanceOf(address(this))
exchangeRate is derived from getCashPrior() + totalBorrows - totalReserves, divided by totalSupply (CToken.sol exchangeRateStoredInternal logic)

mintFresh/mintBehalfFresh increment totalSupply and pull underlying in via doTransferIn, but do not gate or reconcile against balanceOf(address(this)) separately -- any other direct transfer to the contract is reflected in getCashPrior() identically to a transfer that went through mint()

financial_mechanisms.name: Interest Accrual
financial_mechanisms.description: totalBorrows and the borrow index compound over time based on a per-block borrow rate sourced from the external InterestRateModel, applied via accrueInterest(), which is callable by anyone (not admin-gated).
evidence: CToken.sol: accrueInterest() computes borrowRateMantissa via interestRateModel.getBorrowRate(cash, borrows, reserves), then compounds totalBorrows and borrowIndex by the elapsed block delta

implemented_security_mechanisms.name: Admin-Gated Implementation Control
implemented_security_mechanisms.description: Only the admin address can repoint the proxy's implementation.
evidence: require(msg.sender == admin, "CErc20Delegator::_setImplementation: Caller must be admin")

implemented_security_mechanisms.name: Admin-Gated Reserve Factor Control
implemented_security_mechanisms.description: Only the admin address can change a market's reserve factor; the current source implementation reverts with a dedicated custom error rather than a plain require string, distinct from the delegator's own string-revert convention.
evidence: CToken.sol _setReserveFactorFresh: if (msg.sender != admin) { revert SetReserveFactorAdminCheck(); }
ErrorReporter.sol: error SetReserveFactorAdminCheck();

implemented_security_mechanisms.name: Comptroller-Level Pause Guardian
implemented_security_mechanisms.description: A protocol-wide authority, separate from any individual market's admin, can independently freeze new supply or borrow activity per market via the Comptroller.
evidence: require(!mintGuardianPaused[cToken], "mint is paused")
require(!borrowGuardianPaused[cToken], "borrow is paused")

critical_assets.name: Underlying Token Balance Held By Market Contract
critical_assets.description: The pool of underlying assets each market contract directly custodies, read via balanceOf(address(this)) for standard markets and feeding directly into the exchange rate calculation.
evidence: EIP20Interface(underlying).balanceOf(address(this)) inside getCashPrior()

trust_assumptions.name: Single Admin Address Per Market
trust_assumptions.description: Each market's security depends on trusting a single admin address not to repoint the implementation to malicious code or arbitrarily change the reserve factor; the architecture does not itself constrain what kind of address (EOA, multisig, Timelock, DAO) holds this role.
evidence: address payable public admin
No on-chain evidence in the market contract itself establishing whether admin is an EOA or a multi-party governance construct

trust_assumptions.name: Pause Guardian Authority Is Real and Has Been Exercised
trust_assumptions.description: The architecture grants a protocol-wide authority the power to unilaterally and permanently disable new supply/borrow for every market. This is not a purely theoretical trust assumption: real governance history shows this authority being exercised at full protocol scope.
evidence: mintGuardianPaused / borrowGuardianPaused mappings gate every market's mint/borrow path
Compound Community Forum record of a DAO-approved, unanimously supported proposal to pause supply/borrow and raise reserve factors to 100% across all V2 markets, scheduled for execution 20 Oct 2025
